title: Keep native-query replay assertions active in child processes
body:
This fixes a verifier failure mode in [PR #4952](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4952). An isolated Python parent ignores `PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1`, but its child processes can still inherit that variable and disable their mathematical assertions. The wrapper now removes the variable from each child environment, which also protects descendant processes. Its rejection of an optimized parent remains in place.

The [five-line wrapper change](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9c8c1308b0458b8edd9382b0d62ad28f8478f26e/research/legacy-native-query-obstructions/verify.py), [independent environment review](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9c8c1308b0458b8edd9382b0d62ad28f8478f26e/research/legacy-native-query-obstructions/review/WRAPPER-ENV-REVIEW.md), and [fresh mathematical replay receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9c8c1308b0458b8edd9382b0d62ad28f8478f26e/research/legacy-native-query-obstructions/OPTIMIZATION-ENV-VALIDATION.json) bind the correction. The mathematical sources and the scoped lower-bound claims are unchanged. There is no supplier or kappa improvement.

From the repository root, with Python 3 and the standard library, use a new output directory:

```sh
env PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1 python3 -I -B research/legacy-native-query-obstructions/verify.py --work /tmp/native-query-environment-replay
```

Expected final line:

```text
PASS_LEGACY_NATIVE_QUERY_OBSTRUCTIONS checks=5
```

All five actual checks passed with that triggering environment. The independent review separately tested real children and grandchildren at all five dispatch sites: all ten probes had optimization level zero and active assertions. Those probes test the environment contract; they do not replace the mathematical replay. The prior independent mathematical review remains applicable because its proof and checker inputs are unchanged. Original review records are retained alongside the new file manifest.

The correction follows the merged head [159dda696ee2004065d250da76d7d2b94a3e4f21](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/commit/159dda696ee2004065d250da76d7d2b94a3e4f21). The original package and predecessor credit remain as published in PR #4952. The additional evidence records only this verifier correction; no full supplier replay, Lean run, or hosted CI result is claimed. OpenAI Codex assisted this change and its separate agent review. No human review is claimed.
